greeting: ALL ABOARD! Or... wait. Are you boarding? Papers?
Port-Authority Porter! I keep the harbor RUNNING!
You there! Yes, you! Business or pleasure?
Back again? Regular commuter? Or trouble?
Welcome to Central Port! Chaos organized into ORDER!
New arrival? Follow the PROCEDURE! Procedure keeps us ALIVE!
This port moves THOUSANDS daily! I track them ALL!
Authority vested in me! By me! For the GOOD OF ALL!
dialog.port_operations: Ships in! Ships out! Cargo loaded! Cargo unloaded! Passengers processed! It's a BALLET!
dialog.paperwork_demands: Forms! In triplicate! Stamped! Dated! Cross-referenced! The SYSTEM works!
dialog.scheduling_conflicts: Delayed? Early? CANCELLED? Don't blame me! Blame the TIDE! Or the weather! Or fate!
dialog.authority_explanation: I say who boards! Who docks! Who waits! Power? RESPONSIBILITY! Mostly responsibility!
rumor: Tide's port is BUSIEST in the realm! Except Aetherreach. Cheaters. Flying.
Mire's 'port' is three logs and a hope. Amateurs.
Frost's port is FROZEN half the year. Limited schedule.
Ember doesn't have a port. Fire and boats don't mix.
dialog.tourist_advice: First time in Tide? Stay on marked paths! Don't feed seagulls! TIP your dockhands!
farewell: Next departure: SOON! Don't be late!
dialog.time_dawn: First ships! Morning rush! COFFEE NEEDED!
dialog.time_night: Night schedule! Limited service! I'M TIRED!

party_reactions.kade: You run a tight ship. Figuratively. Literally too.
party_reactions.twist: You're like a SHIP CAPTAIN! But for LAND!
party_reactions.renna: Do you use magical scheduling? Time-synced ledgers?
party_reactions.suresh: Authority used well serves many. Used poorly, oppresses.
party_reactions.sova: I'd go crazy with this paperwork. Respect.
party_reactions.grit: Supply lines need coordination. You're the coordinator.
party_reactions.ashka: Order is good. But fire is better.
party_reactions.senna: Knows everything moving. Valuable. Or dangerous.
party_reactions.callum: You look very... official. Is that comfortable?

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Forms first! THEN questions!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Regular! I'll remember your face! Maybe!
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend! Expedited processing! You're welcome!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! VIP status! No lines! EVER!
